name: vCreative
headline: Seven years modernizing the workflow platform behind 9,000+ radio and TV stations
overview: vCreative runs everything between selling an ad and getting it on air for groups such as Cumulus, Cox Media Group, Saga Communications and Hubbard Radio. Since 2019 Techlio has worked as an embedded engineering team on its core web platform: modernizing the front end, building TV production workflows and shipping AI features for order intake and scriptwriting.

metrics.label: hours saved per year across vCreative

challenges.title: Aging front-end stack
challenges.text: An older Angular and PrimeNG version made features slower to ship and releases harder to test across hundreds of screens.

challenges.title: Expanding from radio to TV
challenges.text: TV production needs spot lists, jobs, files, out cues and automated delivery to air, which the radio-first product did not fully support.

challenges.title: Manual order intake and scripts
challenges.text: Sales and production staff typed long production orders and scripts by hand, every day, across thousands of stations.

challenges.title: Enterprise security and control
challenges.text: Multi-market station groups needed role-based access, MFA and reliable notifications for large distributed teams.

solutions.title: Angular 19 and PrimeNG upgrade
solutions.text: The platform was modernized with full regression testing across the Workflow Builder and order screens.

solutions.title: TV production module
solutions.text: A new TV interface with spot lists, jobs, files and out cues, a script editor and automated delivery from studio to air.

solutions.title: AI order intake and scripts
solutions.text: An AI intake workspace with typed prompts and voice-to-text, plus AI-generated scripts inside order forms.

solutions.title: Security and workflow controls
solutions.text: Role-based access and navigation, MFA safeguards, managerial notifications and mobile-friendly order submission.

results: 9,000+ stations and media teams on the platform Techlio helps build
3M+ workflows managed and 300K+ hours saved per year across vCreative
Full Angular 19 and PrimeNG modernization delivered
AI script generation and voice-to-text intake built into order forms
architecture: The front end runs on Angular 19 with PrimeNG, over NestJS services with TypeORM and AWS Lambda for event-driven work. Python services built with Django, PyTorch and Hugging Face libraries handle data analytics and the AI features, with BigQuery for analytics storage and NeMo Guardrails and Presidio as safeguards around AI inputs and outputs.
